anti_promotion_rules: publisher identity alone is not a declaration
acquisition_target_role alone is not a locator declaration
reviewer_disposition alone is not institutional adjudication
rights_disposition alone is not institutional adjudication
counsel request or pending action is not counsel disposition
acquisition receipt or successful retrieval is not provenance admission
manifest requiredness or enum membership is not a value derivation rule
URLs are never converted into source_locator by the adapter
evidence bundle membership is not legal sufficiency
the adapter may not create an authority act or declaration value
claim_ceiling: The adapter freeze establishes only a deterministic, conservative mapping from the exact frozen governance document shapes into the already-frozen v0.2 Facts structure. It establishes no real channel standing, declaration value, rights, provenance truth, legal clearance, redistribution permission, manifest admissibility, or generality.

evidence_binding_rule.provenance_binding: true only when the unique CA-3 acquisition index entry contains nonempty receipt_id and sha256 and CA-3 is listed in the acquisition freeze committed_to_repository_source_ids
evidence_binding_rule.rights_binding: true only when CA-3 rights record contains at least one explicit evidence_hashes entry with nonempty evidence_id and either a nonempty sha256 or explicit http_status

mapping_principle: Map only explicit authority-bearing structures into v0.2 Facts. Absence of an explicit authority act, identity, basis, scoped field coverage, or deterministic rule is mapped to false. Observational, workflow, engineering-review, acquisition, publisher, URL, or required-field metadata never self-promotes into authority.
temporal_version_scope_rule: true only when CA-3 acquisition entry contains nonempty retrieval_utc and acquisition freeze contains nonempty acquisition_tool_version. This establishes record version/temporal scope only, not declaration authority.
